title: Awakening

teacherSummary.text: Walking away, Siddhartha realizes he has always fled from himself and resolves to learn from himself. Suddenly the world appears new and beautiful—colors, rivers, forests—no longer illusion but reality to be experienced. He feels a chill of loneliness: he is no longer a Brahmin or a Samana, but he will not go home.

significance: This epiphany marks the end of Part One and turns him toward sensory life.
